clean_and_category_adjudication: Freeze two counterbalanced short process orders. Every order must improve the inclusive global-attention family and complete kernel sum, keep median span <=+0.5%, keep profiled-child throughput >=-0.5%, and pass exact 12/678 topology/resources/ID/finite/lifecycle/no-compiler checks. No third order or pooled waiver.

Only after both short orders pass, run both complete 18-prompt category/heldout orders with natural greedy h16/h32. Require every train/heldout category decode row positive and aggregate decode positive, E2E/prefill/TTFT within frozen guards, exact IDs/state/lifecycle, and no prompt-conditioned policy.
Promote as the gfx1100 scalar-global default only if every gate passes; otherwise remove runtime ownership while retaining the exact separately registered primitive.

codegen_and_trace.compiler: same AMD Clang 22 gfx1100 decode profile
codegen_and_trace.trace: After non-profiled exact-key prebuild, cache-only rocprofv3 must name the distinct candidate at grid/workgroup 12288/256 for a 48-head layer, plausible duration, finite exact output, expected VGPR/LDS/scratch resources, and no compiler under profiling.

commit_boundaries: Commit this design before repository implementation.
Commit primitive correctness before runtime ownership.
Commit default-off runtime correctness before clean measurement.
Commit retained default or rejection immediately after final adjudication.
correctness: Synthetic live 1/70/126/256 cases cover nonzero page-zero offsets, unused permuted later pages, causal/future token positions, explicit evictions, signed-zero/subnormal/finite BF16 K/V/query values, and F32 output byte identity to global_context_spans.
An independent CPU attention oracle must pass KL<=0.05 and top-1>=90%; candidate versus registered scalar control remains F32 byte-exact.

All 12 actual global-layer outputs at live 70 and 126 must be F32 bit-exact. Repeat the frozen layer-0/44 50-warmup/15-counterbalanced/500-launch gate once and require event and wall wins in all four rows.
primitive_red_green: Add one candidate-specific HIP body/C export, strict Python wrapper/package export, and exact four-axis key; do not mutate global_context_spans or any split/global/SWA primitive.
Validate non-null pointers, Laguna 48/8/128 shape, page-256 spans, and one-page eligibility before or in the launch; live_count>256 must leave a sentinel output untouched.
Register only on hip_gfx1100 and prove gfx1151/cuda/cpu absence. The registered scalar global body is the mandatory primitive fallback.
Primitive admission adds no backend capability, session/runner/CLI selector, allocation, workspace, sidecar, threshold, launch, or default change.
runtime_owner_after_primitive_commit: Only after primitive admission, add a separate false gfx1100 capability and explicit session/CLI opt-in at the global scalar-attention seam. Select only full-attention c=1 with live<=126; default, key miss, explicit disable, live>=127, rows/prefill, gfx1151, and unsupported backends retain registered controls.

Shared-weight mixed_ja_en_review must compare bulk prefill, one captured all-layer decode, 15 further transitions, reset, and eight-token re-prefill. Require full logits/IDs, all 48 hidden and 47 routed boundaries, active K/V and all KVLiveSpans fields, positions, ownership, lifecycle, KL=0, and top-1 100%.

A cache-only short trace must record exactly 12 candidate calls/token, zero scalar-control global calls, unchanged retained split/SWA owners, and exactly 678 model kernels/token. A live>=127 fallback trace/test must record zero candidate calls and unchanged split-exact ownership.

Do not restore D15/D17 attention-boundary bundles: their complete category gates rejected the owners despite mechanical wins.
Do not retry adjacent-head K/V sharing: the LPF-5 production global leaf regressed 45.00% after halving per-head token parallelism.
Do not alter the retained split-exact producer/reducer, wave-local SWA reducer, head+KV fusion, gate fusion, or live>=127 crossover in this candidate.
Do not add prompt IDs, token IDs, prompt-conditioned branches, or any fixed-suite reranking; eligibility is derived only from span geometry and retained dispatch thresholds.

lineage.result: Only already-catalogued unrelated external drift; no parent change affects this in-tree scalar global-attention address specialization.

modeled_ceiling.method: Apply only the smallest actual layer/live improvement across HIP-event and synchronized-wall medians to the immutable retained short global-attention family; leave every other kernel and host interval unchanged.
modeled_ceiling.note: The modeled short row is planning evidence only. Full-suite prompts cross live 127 at different natural positions, so no canonical throughput gain is claimed before complete category adjudication.

selected_design.description: For live_count within one 256-token global page, replace only the two physical-slot page-table translations with base_offsets[0] * 256 + token. Keep score/value token traversal, FMA order, max/sum reduction order, BF16 loads, causal/eviction tests, barriers, local256 geometry, dynamic LDS sizing, and F32 stores unchanged.
fallbacks: global_context_spans for explicit disable, key miss, live_count outside runtime eligibility, rows/prefill, gfx1151, and unsupported backends
the registered unfused attention plus gate chain remains available below split threshold
selected_design.name: exact single-page scalar global-attention decode
ownership_invariants: Consume the complete KVLiveSpans ABI: base_offsets[0], live_counts, token_positions, evict_mask, and row_positions; no dense context_len/block-table shortcut is introduced.
One workgroup still owns one query head, with 256 threads/eight wave32 waves, unchanged dynamic score/query storage, and unchanged five barriers.
All score FMAs, shuffle trees, max/denominator ordering, exponentiation, normalized value FMAs, and final F32 stores remain source-identical.
No allocation, workspace, sidecar, weight copy, launch contraction, gate/head-KV change, split-threshold change, or prompt-conditioned policy is introduced.
All 12 global calls remain one-for-one, so intended short topology stays 678 model kernels/token.
selected_design.primitive_validity: live_count <= block_size == 256; the device body returns without writing when live_count exceeds one page
selected_design.runtime_eligibility: gfx1100 full-attention c=1 scalar path only, live_count <= 126; live>=127 keeps retained split-exact ownership
selected_design.why_distinct: The retained scalar global path is selected only below global_split_min_live=127, so every visible logical slot is necessarily in physical page zero. Prior rejected attention candidates changed head ownership, softmax association, or fused boundaries; this candidate changes only exact address translation under a mechanically provable one-page predicate.
